visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair lies comfortably on a white bed, smiling warmly towards the camera with her eyes squinted happily. She holds a translucent pink bottle in one hand and a pink tube in the other, both featuring delicate floral and ribbon designs on their labels. The lighting is soft, warm, and golden, creating a cozy, intimate bedroom atmosphere. (2) The scene shifts to a bright, modern bathroom where the woman stands before a large mirror. She gently touches her neck with her right hand, wearing a white off-the-shoulder top. Two pink skincare products sit neatly on a small built-in recessed wall shelf. The background consists of light-colored tiles and clean bathroom fixtures. (3) Close-up shots focus on the product packaging and textures. A hand dispenses a clear, viscous gel from a pink tube onto a palm, then adds water and rubs hands together to create a dense, white, foamy lather. The lighting remains bright and natural, highlighting the reflective surfaces of the product containers. (4) A demonstration involves a halved, oxidized pear under a chrome faucet. One half is rinsed with clear water while the other half is scrubbed with the white foam from the cleansing product. A split-screen comparison follows, showing the pear half washed with the product appearing significantly brighter and cleaner than the water-only side. (5) The woman returns to the bedroom setting, lying on the bed and smiling brightly at the camera while holding the pink products. She wears delicate gold bracelets on her wrist. The final frame features the products placed on a neutral background with the brand logo "SHILLS" appearing prominently in the center.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody accompanied by soft percussive beats. A friendly, high-pitched female voice narrates with clear articulation and moderate speed, asking an introductory question "你知道嗎？". The vocal energy is positive and welcoming, with no audible background noise. (2) As the narration continues, distinct post-production "pop" and "whoosh" sound effects are heard, synchronized with the appearance of on-screen text and scene transitions. The background music maintains a consistent, upbeat rhythm, providing a steady harmonic bed under the clear, well-enunciated voiceover. (3) The sound of a running faucet—a medium-bandwidth splashing sound—is introduced during the product demonstration phase. This real-world incidental sound is layered beneath the narration and music, which remain the dominant audio signals. The speaker's tone becomes more informative and authoritative as she explains the product benefits. (4) A bright, high-frequency "ding" sound effect marks the successful result of the pear cleansing experiment. The narrator’s voice exhibits moderate pitch variability, reflecting an engaging and persuasive emotional state. The acoustic environment sounds like a clean studio recording with professional-grade clarity and no distortion. (5) The video concludes with the narrator stating a final brand message. The background music swells slightly before fading out alongside the voice. The overall audio mix is balanced, with a high signal-to-noise ratio and deliberate use of SFX to emphasize key marketing points throughout the presentation.
